declared_episode_coverage_exact.evidence: 51 exact committed identities in execution order; Run1 reused, never rerun

raw_receipts_and_hashes_complete.evidence: All 51 local run manifests and both-host raw manifests rehashed; receipt telemetry hashes matched

strongest_supported_mechanism: Within the tested two-host X-VLA/LIBERO deployment, the persistent executor and startup/steady budget split removed the timeout-reconnect-cold-start amplification observed in v1. Cold compute itself remained about 7 s; successful reconnect-first compute p50/p95 was 90/113 ms.
strongest_negative_result: The original all-fault recovery gate remains FAIL (97/100; terminal events in Runs23,39,47). The 950 ms condition also produced 87.58-88.30% post-first-action polling depletion despite task success.
claim_limitations: Outcome-informed revised v2 protocol, historical cohort; not independent v1 replication or unseen-state generalization.
Task success is descriptive; 3 paired resets per family/condition, 5 no-fault resets; no statistical superiority claim.
Application delivery jitter and explicit pre-inference disconnect over SSH forwarding; not kernel netem.
No CUDA preemption; final stop can invalidate an in-flight result.
OS executor thread ID is not exported; persistence uses unchanged server PID, executor_starts=1 and frozen sole-thread architecture.
Approximate 1 Hz nvidia-smi sampling can miss peaks. GPU episode window uses B UTC against A sample UTC without independent clock synchronization.
Queue-depletion ratios count polling events, not fraction of physical control time. Post-first starts at first accepted valid chunk.
Warm successful steady requests exclude failed/cancelled requests, process-first and reconnect-first; failures and their elapsed times remain in raw telemetry.
Service interval non-overlap reconstruction tolerates 1 ms timestamp/logging lag; frozen serialization is the primary concurrency evidence.
Run1 PCAP lost 13 kernel packets in request direction, while all accepted action responses and durable logs were complete. Runs2-51 capture response direction only.
No additional mid-episode reset schedule was injected; reset invariants apply to the fixed initial-reset/stop lifecycle.

Server process VRAM samples include isolated 6246 MiB (Run24) and 12890 MiB (Run34) peaks. They are retained as observed; no allocator trace establishes their cause, and device/process nvidia-smi queries are sequential rather than atomic.
Post-hoc censoring is termination-dependent and may be informative; 97/97 is descriptive, not an unbiased recovery probability or a new gate.
A cancelled attempt's hypothetical outcome if the episode had continued is unknown; no counterfactual guarantee is inferred.
Client and engine timestamps are from the same host. No cross-host clock subtraction is needed for opportunity classification.
raw_evidence_policy: Raw GPU logs, captures, model/assets and archives remain ignored; tracked summaries reference verified hashes. No new GPU experiment or diagnostic was run for consolidation.
